LLaDA x TSP experiment library

Public URL: https://aleksyar.github.io/diffusionllm/

This is an independent section of the existing website. Do not add a link to
the homepage. The homepage and its main/ assets are intentionally unchanged.

The site is a snapshot of the saved DiffusionLLM experiment dashboards. The
public export includes all registered/discovered entries, report pages and
their permitted dependencies. Local paths are anonymized; operational
authorization fields are omitted. Large training data, weights, scripts and
some logs are retained in the research workspace and labelled as local files.
publication.json records coverage, file hashes and the exact snapshot time.

To refresh after collecting more experimental results:

1. In the DiffusionLLM workspace, rebuild the normal dashboards:
   .venv/bin/python dashboard/build.py

2. Export from that workspace into this checkout's diffusionllm/ directory:
   .venv/bin/python dashboard/export_public_site.py \
     --workspace /absolute/path/to/DiffusionLLM \
     --destination /absolute/path/to/aleksyar.github.io/diffusionllm

   A copy of the exporter is also kept in .github/scripts/export-diffusionllm.py.
   It accepts the same arguments and needs Python 3.9 or newer.

3. Review the export and publication.json, then commit the diffusionllm/ changes
   and push to main. The existing GitHub Pages deployment publishes the update.

The exporter checks all local HTML links/fragments, experiment coverage, JSON
syntax, source consistency and credential-like patterns before replacing the
previous export. Original evidence is not modified. No cluster work is run.

The root .nojekyll file preserves the existing HTML and the report/evidence
file names without Jekyll processing. No new hosting service is used.
